d:
The 76ers defeated the Bucks, 132-129 tonight in Philadelphia. Joel Embiid contributed a team-high 26 points to go with 17 rebounds and 9 assists, with LeBron James of the 76ers adding an additional 21 points (9-14 FG) in the game. Tyler Herro finished with a career-high 50 points along with 11 rebounds for the Bucks in the losing effort. The 76ers improve their record to 14-3 with the win, while the Bucks fall to 1-16 for the season.
